author: Scott; Patterson
terms: Push remaining Pennsylvania/New Jersey quotas towards Frederick, Hagerstown and Cumberland to threaten Harpers Ferry and support Union sentiment in western Virginia; a distant Cumberland garrison must be self-relying.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Patterson May24 expressly acknowledges two same-day telegrams; Scott order reproduced in Hamilton to McClellan May26.
limit: Pre-June antecedent; the May26 forwarding is not Patterson receipt. No delivery time.

author: Porter by Patterson
terms: Organize at Chambersburg; Thomas cavalry/three infantry regiments first to Hagerstown; Williams next; third/fourth brigades by available rail; shift depot with forces; wait for Patterson unless imperative circumstances demand movement and telegraph him.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Copy enclosed with Patterson June1 plan. No separate Keim acknowledgment found in read pages.
limit: Directions and intended columns, not proof they marched on May29.

author: Scott
terms: If Harpers Ferry is first object, may meanwhile neglect Cumberland/intermediate points; one field battery; ford above Williamsport; notify readiness to cross for demonstration beyond Alexandria; report freely.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Patterson June1 replies to same-date telegram and acknowledges offered artillery (pp657-658); no clock.
limit: Do not turn promised demonstration into a completed act or Cumberland abandonment.

author: Patterson via Townsend
terms: Turn Harpers Ferry: cross near Williamsport with support threatening Shepherdstown, occupy Martinsburg unless enemy too strong/threatening march line; then attack through Shepherdstown or cut Winchester railway retreat; securely advance on Winchester after Harpers Ferry falls. Collect unaccoutered York/Lancaster regiments at Chambersburg; others follow.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Townsend June3 says plan received yesterday (p660): June2 receipt [I] of this plan, not a proved clock or distinct signed acceptance.
limit: Conditional multi-stage proposal; nominal regiments/estimated strength not a known-strength roster.

author: Patterson
terms: Ready Thursday morning for proposed plan; will move if Scott approves. Longer letter plans advance Thursday, Thomas through Hagerstown Saturday to seize Williamsport ford and send pickets beyond; Williams supports; artillery needed for Martinsburg.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Townsend same-day reply says instructions will follow and plan received June2. Patterson postscript at9pm says telegram just received and he will await instructions (p661).
limit: Patterson proposed schedule, not executed dates; June2 identification is inference.

author: Townsend by Scott
terms: No forward movement until joined by Fourth Artillery battery and five Third Infantry companies; horses/equipment at Carlisle; retain two Ohio regiments if they come and first two northern regiments passing Harrisburg; letter to follow.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Patterson June7 says he will not advance beyond Greencastle in face of Scott order against forward movement (p669). No exact unique-paper receipt given.
limit: Order prescribes actual reinforcement, not arrival on a calendar date.

author: Patterson
terms: Thomas moved to Greencastle; wants Hagerstown roads/depot and Boonsborough flank position; will not go beyond Greencastle against Scott restraint. A second letter reports staged brigades and anticipates readiness when Third Infantry/battery arrive.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Own report; no headquarters receipt stamp in read pages.
limit: Two same-day letters, second continues p670; not evidence requested reinforcements already joined.

author: Porter by Patterson
terms: No permanent advance until supported by whole force; ignore appeals to cross into Virginia; overpower Maryland inroads within reach then return to camp; Williams supports.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: No separate Thomas acknowledgment in read pages.
limit: A limited defensive exception, not unrestricted crossing authority.

kind: approval with caution and support plan
author: Scott
terms: Expedition well projected; no reverse/check/drawn battle acceptable; Burnside regiment/battery and regulars sent towards Carlisle; Stone secondary expedition to Edwards Ferry/Leesburg and mutual communication if practicable; no clear Alexandria diversion beyond railroad repair; attempt nothing without clear success prospect.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: No distinct receipt date in read June correspondence. June18 Patterson calls original plan approved (p701), without identifying receipt of this letter.
limit: Approval is not unconditional execution; claimed enemy numbers remain Scott judgment.

author: Patterson; Townsend by Scott
terms: Patterson presses for New York and New Jersey regiments amid conflicting directions; Scott through Townsend directs Small and Einstein regiments to his column.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Patterson acknowledges Cameron note; no separate receipt for Townsend reinforcement telegram.
limit: Office conflict and wanted force, not another numerical return or fulfilled transfer.

author: Patterson
terms: Report Wallace at Cumberland; propose two regiments protecting B&O rear to let him work east; wagons constrain main force; depot Hagerstown Saturday then headquarters; Cadwalader to Greencastle for First/Third/Fourth brigades.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Own letter and telegram; actual headquarters arrival reported June15 (p689).
limit: Projected10,000 ahead of Hagerstown is expectation, not achieved strength.

author: Porter by Patterson
terms: Saturday: Thomas to Williamsport and protect ford by artillery; Miles behind/right; Williams towards Sharpsburg; Wynkoop via Hagerstown to Funkstown; Negley reserve/guards Hagerstown-Williamsport; continuous pickets, mutual support, drill. Cadwalader locates camps; Keim supervises departure.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Patterson June15 reports advanced brigades (p686); Burnside June22 reports June15 march/arrival Williamsport (p715). No recipient clock for circular.
limit: Intended synchronized positions distinct from execution; map towns share coarse regions.

author: Townsend by Scott
terms: Supposes crossing17th/18th and McDowell demonstration1-2 days before; do not hasten; keep Scott informed; Stone may join if expedient; William Johnston sent to seek intelligence.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Patterson June14 says note of13th received by Lieut O.B. and cannot cross indicated time (p683); printed response does not uniquely separate the two June13 notes.
limit: 17/18 are suppositions, not deadline or executed crossing.

author: Patterson
terms: Strong force ahead of Hagerstown15th; others follow as transport permits; beyond telegraph with one daily mail; asks twice-daily mail.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Cameron endorsement approves June15.
limit: Mail approval not Scott operational permission or receipt by field force.

author: Townsend by Scott
terms: Reports McCulloch sharpshooters and expected determined stand at Harpers Ferry; suggests sharpshooters to meet them; Lieutenant Babcock to carry letter/report for duty.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Patterson June14 acknowledges a13th note via Lieut O.B. (p683); cannot assign separate precise receipt to each13th paper.
limit: Enemy report is attributed information, not truth.

author: Patterson; Porter
terms: Cannot cross at indicated time and will give warning; Porter describes strained next-day advance, transport/battery delays, evacuation rumors unconfirmed by own spies; plan conditional Stone cooperation.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Patterson explicitly acknowledges13th note; headquarters receipt of these replies unstated.
limit: Porter letter is staff assessment, not an extra Scott order or proof of evacuation.

author: Porter by Patterson
terms: Will notify readiness to strike enemy left for cooperation if Stone judges circumstances permit; ask his position and which heights he can threaten, and whether he can stop Frederick supplies.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: No separate Stone receipt in read pages.
limit: Cooperation requested, not assured.

author: Porter by Patterson
terms: Threaten Maryland Heights; turn left via/near Martinsburg; cut communications/attack; strong supporting column; mature division plans. Near Williamsport avoid major collision/uncertain Virginia entry before support ready; repel annoying/destructive/incurring parties with overpowering force.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Patterson June15 reports Cadwalader ordered utmost caution (p686); separate receipt clock absent.
limit: Design under reconnaissance; do not convert threat duty to a forced frontal attack.

author: Patterson
terms: First four brigades and part fifth advanced under Cadwalader beyond Hagerstown; Patterson/staff going today. Newton reports Harpers Ferry abandoned/destroyed; Patterson fears decoy.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Own report.
limit: Belief initially reserved despite report; arrival not yet established in this paper.

author: Porter by Patterson
terms: Two letters: aid Newton reconnaissance; if enemy vacated, send portion or whole division across Williamsport, advance parties and annoy retreat if safe; advance Williams towards Shepherdstown and Wynkoop towards river; occupy Harpers Ferry if abandoned and safe; report by express.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: June16 Patterson says Cadwalader will cross under his instructions and telegram reports he did (pp691-692); no separate Cadwalader clock for crossing letters.
limit: Permission follows evacuation report; cannot be recycled as cause of an earlier evacuation warning.

author: Porter by Patterson; Cadwalader
terms: If enemy certainly gone/cannot injure him, detach artillery section, cavalry squadron, three infantry regiments for Cumberland; no risk to own force. Cadwalader twice says insufficient transport, fatigue, information and hazardous weakening.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Cadwalader June15 replies to assistance letter and explicitly says yours of this date received (pp688-689).
limit: Same-date acknowledgments concern relief; not precise confirmation of every crossing instruction.

author: Patterson
terms: Headquarters established Hagerstown6pm; reports Harpers Ferry still occupied by500 breaking camp at2pm, destruction and rebels gone to Winchester.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Printed received11.15pm June15.
limit: The500 and destruction are reported intelligence; not exhaustive inventory or omniscient troop location.

author: Townsend by Scott
addressee: Du Barry, copy onward to Patterson
terms: All regiments arriving Harrisburg now to Washington; Patterson needs no more; acknowledge and send to Patterson.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Forwarding required, but receipt by Patterson not given.
limit: Not identical to later recall of regulars already with field column.

author: Patterson
terms: Cadwalader waded Williamsport ford today; detailed letter says occupy bend to Falling Waters, explore Martinsburg, supported by Wynkoop/Negley; Burnside relief towards Cumberland.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Own same-day telegram; June18 letter says crossing executed before receipt of regulars recall (p701).
limit: Crossing of part of army, not proof whole army/9,000 crossed on16th; planned9,000 over16th-17th appears p693.

author: Scott
terms: At11am asks proposed pursuit consequent on evacuation; recommends none specially; if no pursuit send all regular horse/foot and Rhode Island regiment at once.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: June16 Patterson says no pursuit possible, asks retain regulars if not urgent; long letter says recall telegram at hand (pp691-694). No exact arrival time.
limit: Issue11am is not receipt11am; not a direct Scott order to recross.

kind: new plan and reservation under recall
author: Patterson
terms: No pursuit; proposes Harpers Ferry depot/headquarters, B&O east/west, staged Winchester/Strasburg advance, reinforced Cumberland-Romney/Moorefield column; requests McClellan cooperation/control; continue views until checked; asks regulars remain temporarily.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Acknowledges recall in same letter; dispatch goes by Colonel Sherman according to telegram.
limit: Submitted broader plan, not accepted doctrine or accomplished relocation; claims rout/fear are his interpretation.

author: Scott
terms: Challenges Winchester detachment as useless if strong/destroyed if weak; prioritizes Arlington/Alexandria; regulars needed there; send regulars and Rhode Islanders as disengaged; stay within limits pending convincing information; report.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Patterson June18 refers receipt that night of recall/keep within limits (p701), understood as June16 night [I]; no minute.
limit: Do not collapse this into an enemy-superiority fallback or an absolute never-cross order.

kind: recall transmission and readiness to recross
author: Porter by Patterson
terms: Immediately on receipt send Rhode Island regiment/battery back secretly via Hagerstown/Frederick/rail Washington; stop Cumberland cavalry; be ready to fall back to Maryland; further orders tomorrow noon.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: No separate receipt stamp; Burnside later reports Monday recall and return(pp715-716).
limit: Be ready is not completed recrossing.

author: Patterson; Scott
terms: Patterson asks Harpers Ferry advance/bridge plan; if regulars withdrawn, will withdraw. Scott says pressed here, send twice-requested troops without delay.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Porter17th order quotes Scott pressed (same page); no independent time of Scott receipt.
limit: Withdrawal is Patterson consequence of recall, not Scott military-condition discretion.

author: Porter by Patterson
terms: Thomas regulars via Frederick to Washington; Miles with Second/Third/Eighth Infantry via Hagerstown/Harrisburg rail; withdraw command to Maryland.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Cadwalader June18 reports positive withdrawal orders, incomplete communication, and returned undelivered messenger order (pp703-704); no clock identifying each relay.
limit: Keep actual delivery failures; do not infer arrival to every brigade from divisional receipt.

author: Patterson
terms: Miles infantry left8pm via Harrisburg; Thomas via Frederick planned for transport; all force this side of river; later9.30pm claims Johnston large force at Martinsburg advancing Williamsport.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Own telegram; later documents qualify both movement completion and enemy report.
limit: All-this-side statement conflicts with Cadwalader June18 report of seven regiments across overnight; not silently harmonized.

author: Cadwalader; Porter by Patterson
terms: At7.5pm Cadwalader reports rumors Johnston15,000 at Martinsburg approaching ford, asks regulars return. Porter halts Thomas/Miles/Burnside, calls battery, orders concentrated defense/pickets and supporting brigades by dawn.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: June18 Patterson acknowledges Cadwalader report caused temporary regulars diversion (pp700-701).
limit: Rumor not confirmed truth; order to halt Burnside not proof successful recall (p700 says sent off though recalled).

author: Patterson
terms: Thomas/Miles temporarily stopped against perceived attack; says troops now Maryland and infantry detached after safety secured. Long account says crossing before recall; recall/limits that night led return order; volunteer execution deferred. Proposes bridge/fortified Harpers Ferry base and optional Winchester advance.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Own retrospective account of preceding days; original June17/18 minute-by-minute execution remains unresolved.
limit: Reports state1man shot; no clean instant all-regulars removal; avoid exact bulk recross date.

author: Cadwalader
terms: Seven regiments and First Philadelphia City Troop across overnight despite orders; suspects brigade communication failed; messenger order returned undelivered after man shot; withdrawing as safely possible; ford4feet/debris; enemy reports unsettled.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Division commander own report on June18; proves known failed delivery rather than automatic obedience.
limit: Patterson June17 all-force-back claim is not compatible literally; exact last crossing clock unknown.

author: Scott
terms: 9.15pm: expected temporary retention/recall of regulars when Johnston reappeared until importance known; await information; keep siege guns and Perkins light battery.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Patterson June19 explicitly says just received at12.15pm (p707).
limit: This permission cannot operate on18th issue time or retroactively authorize previous delays.

kind: receipt, present ford hold and proposed move
author: Patterson
terms: At12.15pm acknowledges18th9.15pm telegram; explains withdrawal due inability hold bend without regulars; Miles sent; Thomas held subject call. Plans Maryland Heights/bridge/Harpers Ferry, then abandons Heights plan when railroad company refuses repair without whole line protected; focuses Williamsport.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Exact received12.15pm19th.
limit: Changed plan is not proof Maryland Heights occupied on20th.

kind: split cavalry recall and local discretion
author: Scott
terms: 9.45pm: doubts serious threat to Wallace; suggests absorbing him but govern by better local information; retain two Thomas horse companies and send Thomas with other two; Palmer temporarily.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: No exact Patterson receipt in read pages.
limit: Two retained is later qualification, not full restoration of recalled regulars.

author: Scott
terms: Examine Maryland Heights for battery; promptly propose force to sweep Leesburg towards Alexandria in cooperation, absorb Stone, remainder cover Heights detachment.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Patterson June21 says received at midnight (pp711-712); boundary20/21 retained, no timezone precision added.
limit: Request for plan, not an issued march-to-Leesburg order.

author: Porter by Patterson
terms: Towards Sharpsburg/Bakersville, pickets Mercersville/Sharpsburg; protect local people without being cut off; Smith selects defensive ground, Owen follows; contact Cadwalader.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Patterson June21 says reports enemy returned to Harpers Ferry reached him yesterday and caused strong Sharpsburg dispatch (p712); no Negley receipt clock.
limit: A threatened return report drives this, not a date or certified enemy location.

author: Patterson
terms: Acknowledges plan request: occupy Maryland Heights with2,100 brigade, artillery and20days supplies; move depot Frederick/abandon present line; rest cross near Point of Rocks and join Stone Leesburg. Requests approval; reconnaissance underway.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Own reply to received20th telegram; no Scott acceptance of this plan in read pre25June correspondence.
limit: Not authority for whole army to march to Leesburg; projected2,100 not measured return.

author: Porter by Patterson via McCall
terms: Join main force, active operations anticipated and relief too difficult; route left to Wallace judgment; ammunition sent Tuesday.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Patterson June22 says called yesterday (p715); original Wallace receipt not given.
limit: No date-only relocation of Wallace.

kind: reconnaissance report and renewed advance proposal
author: Patterson
terms: Partial Newton Heights reconnaissance received; water difficulty; suggests support in Pleasant Valley. Deserter enemy estimates attributed; would advance whole force to Winchester once battery harness ready if Scott approves; fears reinforcing main enemy by driving him away.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Own received Newton information; no Scott reply/approval in read pre25June window.
limit: No new approved Winchester offensive on23rd; estimates remain beliefs.

author: Porter by Patterson
terms: Orders him to headquarters by shortest route unless strong unanticipated reasons against it.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: No Wallace receipt or actual arrival in read pre25June correspondence.
limit: Reiteration distinct from21st request; no asserted compliance.

author: Burnside
terms: Reports arrival Chambersburg11th, Greencastle then Williamsport noon Saturday15th; battery part across Sunday16th, recalled Monday17th; via Hagerstown/Boonsborough/Middletown to Frederick, rail18th7pm, Washington19th6am.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Retrospective report dated22nd; actual receipt at Scott unstated.
limit: Rhode Island regiment/battery is not a Regular Army regiment; cannot use its completed return as all regulars receipt.

author: Porter by Patterson
terms: Halt Cumberland, secure Potomac/Green Spring Run bridges, await further orders; gather intelligence; if armed offensive bodies not too strong for safely detached force, capture/rout by surprise if possible; report frequently.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Wallace June11 says Closson delivered dispatches that morning shortly after arrival (p676). Identification with6th supported by Patterson11th report (p105), not an itemized delivery list.
limit: General authority, not a recovered Patterson target-specific raid-on-Romney letter.

author: Wallace; Patterson forwarded by Townsend
terms: Wallace acknowledges instructions delivered by Closson; over800 effective whole regiment. Patterson says Cumberland occupied yesterday and Wallace acts on6th instructions; will call on small militia parties.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Scott office received Patterson dispatch afternoon11th and forwards copy to Stone9pm(p105); Wallace own dispatch receipt morning11th.
limit: June10 occupation in Patterson conflicts with Wallace arrival wording June11; preserve, not recertify one date. Whole800+ differs from raid500.

author: Wallace
terms: On reports of several hundred armed men at Romney, Wallace determined to disperse them; left Cumberland12th10pm, eight companies about500 of Eleventh Indiana, rail21miles New Creek then march across mountains; reaches near Romney about8am13th, attacks bridge/house then battery flank.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Report dated14th; no target-specific order receipt; enemy pickets alarmed before arrival according to Wallace.
limit: Wallace tactical decision under standing authority. Printed4am march/6am intended/8am arrival timings and distances not repaired; not exact independent verification.

author: Wallace
terms: Enemy guns leave; no horse for pursuit; enters town/searches arms and stores; returns same road to Cumberland camp11pm, route vulnerability compels return. Reports87total miles/46on foot in24hours; already received Patterson approval.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Return13th11pm inferred [I] from12th10pm departure,13th operation and24hour description; exact approval paper/time not read.
limit: No sustained Romney occupation, cavalry/artillery in attacking force, or reinforcement invented from opponent estimates. Published route distance/time arithmetic not independently reconciled.

author: Wallace; Patterson
terms: Wallace hears4,000 expected Romney and seeks aid. Patterson orders bold front, relief towards Hancock and if hard pressed retirement Hancock or at discretion Bedford; sends aid with Burnside, then regulars/Rhode Island recalled.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Wallace June18 acknowledges Porter letter by messenger and says scouts nearly Romney see no enemy(p704); no exact15th order receipt.
limit: Reported4,000 not actual force; fallback authority distinct from13th raid return.

author: Johnston
terms: Morning informant near Hagerstown reports Chambersburg arrivals totaling10,100; woman note shown yesterday predicts advance via Hagerstown/Greencastle; railroad officer note predicts meeting Ohio forces between Cumberland/Hagerstown; press confirms; hears Grafton occupation via telegraph. Warns west/junction knowledge poor.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Johnston explicitly dates morning information31May and note shown30May; underlying Tuesday/Wednesday retained rather than converted to invented precise arrival clocks.
limit: These are claims/expectations, not true Union strength or June13raid/June16crossing reports.

author: Johnston
terms: River watched Point of Rocks to western Berkeley, distant reaches Stuart cavalry; Patterson near Williamsport reported18,000 by well-informed persons; McClellan supposedly approaching junction.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Report gives no receipt day for18,000 or supposed junction; contemporary17June also states18,000 belief(p934).
limit: Later interested report; do not assign13June receipt to undated estimate.

author: Johnston
terms: Morning13June information from Winchester says Romney occupied by2,000 Federal troops, supposedly McClellan vanguard; Hill troops sent railway Winchester then towards Romney; baggage removed13th-14th and bridges destroyed.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Explicit reported receipt morning13June; upstream Winchester reporter/original paper not recovered.
limit: 2,000 is Johnston received estimate, incompatible with treating actual raid500 as his knowledge; timing of same-morning rumor/raid not independently reconciled.

author: Johnston
terms: Main army leaves15th towards Winchester; morning16th hears Patterson crossed Williamsport and Romney force fell back; courier discretion also placed16th; redirects towards Bunker Hill.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Dates from October report, distinguished from contemporary17June phrasing and15June authority acknowledgment.
limit: Do not backdate16th crossing news to cause13th preparations/15th departure. Claimed enemy recross due him is his causal account, not sole established cause.

author: Johnston
terms: Camp Long Meadow: June13letter received; says reported troop removal and authorized matters to President yesterday.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Acknowledgment by15th, exact receipt unstated; earlier report to President would be14th [I] but original not read.
limit: Conflicts with simple October departure15th/permission16th chain. Pages931-933 contain other correspondents, no extra Johnston threat receipt.

author: Johnston
terms: Morning16th apparently reliable intelligence no enemy advancing Romney and Hagerstown troops would cross yesterday; therefore directs army Bunker Hill,12miles ahead Winchester. Believes enemy18,000 vs own6,500; Stuart intelligence last night says enemy camped yesterday afternoon8miles from Martinsburg.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: 16thmorning receipt; Stuart received16thevening [I] from last night in17thletter. Cross yesterday refers16June in17thheading; preserve future-vs-completed wording difference from October.
limit: Not proof Union actually had18,000, marched to Martinsburg, or Johnston received Scott papers.

author: Cooper
terms: Acknowledges June17letter delivered this day by Colonel Thomas; ammunition and special train; reaffirms circumstantial discretion.
receipt_or_execution_evidence: Explicit government receipt18June; not receipt by Johnston of reply.
limit: No separate new threat report to Johnston; continuation on935 not adopted here.
